name: Harshit
tagline: DevOps & Cloud Engineer in the making
about: I automate things so I don't have to do them twice, then spend three hours debugging the automation. My pipelines are green, my coffee is strong, and "it works on my machine" is no longer an excuse, because I put my machine in a Docker container.
quotes: Keep learning, keep growing, and never stop exploring.
Success begins when you decide to take action.
Every small step you take brings you closer to your goals.
Keep moving forward, even when progress feels slow.
Your mindset can be your greatest strength or your biggest barrier.
Challenge yourself today to become better tomorrow.
Imagine it. Create it. Make it happen.
Consistent effort can turn ordinary skills into extraordinary results.
Every setback is another opportunity to learn and grow.
Build your future one line of code at a time.
